Title: RISE AGAIN

FADE IN:

INT. PETERSON PARK - EARLY MORNING

Coach CALHOUN, late forties, wearing a weathered PETERSON HIGH letterman jacket, walks the track, a stopwatch around his neck, a clipboard in his hand. The sun rises over the empty, dew-kissed football field.

INT. PETERSON HIGH SCHOOL - MORNING

CALHOUN enters the empty, dimly lit school, passing through the quiet halls. He stops in the library, his eyes filling with sadness as he looks at old yearbooks and trophies. He sits at a table and pulls out a worn notebook.

NARRATION (CALHOUN)
I didn't get here by accident. My dreams were born right here in this very room. This town, this school, this team... it's who I am. But now, I'm faced with my biggest challenge yet.

INT. PE TEACHER'S LOUNGE - DAY

CALHOUN sits at a table with other PE TEACHERS, talking about their students.

TEACHER 1
Did you hear about Jimmy down at the middle school? He tried out for the soccer team and didn't make it. Now his parents are threatening to move.

CALHOUN (angrily)
We can't let that happen. We need to do better by our kids.

INT. PETERSON HIGH - GYM - DAY

CALHOUN stands in front of the gym mirror, taking off his jacket to reveal his scars. He lifts a dumbbell, flexing his muscles.

NARRATION (CALHOUN)
I've been there. I've failed. But I've learned that you can always rise again.

INT. PETERSON HIGH - CAFETERIA - DAY

CALHOUN addresses the student body.

CALHOUN
I want to start a new football program. For those who want it, who are willing to put in the work, who are determined to succeed.

A student, MARK, steps forward.

MARK
I'm in.

INT. PETERSON HIGH - GRASS FIELD - DAY

The team practices, struggling, but determined.

INT. PETERSON HIGH - GYM - NIGHT

CALHOUN sits with a discouraged MARK.

CALHOUN
You have what it takes. You just need to believe in yourself.

MARK
I do believe in myself, but it's hard when everyone else seems to doubt me.

CALHOUN
You can't control what others think. You can only control how you respond.

INT. PETERSON HIGH - CAFETERIA - DAY

The team is mocked and ridiculed by the older, more established football team.

CALHOUN
(to his team)
We're not going to let them define us. We're going to rise again.

INT. PETERSON HIGH - GRASS FIELD - DAY

The team practices, working harder than ever, building camaraderie and determination.

INT. PETERSON HIGH - GYM - NIGHT

The older football team challenges the new team to a scrimmage. The new team loses, but they don't give up.

INT. PETERSON HIGH - CAFETERIA - DAY

CALHOUN addresses the student body once more.

CALHOUN
We may have lost, but we didn't quit. We're going to keep fighting. We're going to rise again.

INT. PETERSON HIGH - GRASS FIELD - DAY

The team practices, and practices some more. They grow stronger, both physically and mentally.

INT. PETERSON HIGH - GYM - NIGHT

The older football team challenges the new team to another scrimmage. This time, the new team wins.

INT. PETERSON HIGH - CAFETERIA - DAY

The student body celebrates the new team's victory. CALHOUN stands proudly, knowing he's given his students the belief and determination they needed to succeed.

CALHOUN
(to the team)
We've risen again. Now let's keep climbing.

FADE OUT.
